---
title: "Germany organic fertiliser: market-entry and regulatory evidence screen"
subtitle: "Independent, reproducible research companion | illustrative quantitative inputs"
---

**Research object.** Route-specific PFC/CMC evidence register, unit economics, landed-cost sensitivity and decision gates.

**Status.** Exploratory feasibility / evidence-screening code. The inputs that come with this repository are **constructed for demonstration**; they are not observed project results or validation of external frameworks.

**Open the analysis:** [Methods](reports/methods.qmd), [Reproducible report](reports/analysis.qmd), [Boundaries](reports/limitations.qmd).

The source-to-claim audit is in [SOURCE_REGISTER.md](docs/SOURCE_REGISTER.md). Research use requires evaluating the [publication checklist](docs/PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md).
